steps.title: Triage
steps.note: Triage: the doctor hands you Triage Bandages; use those, not your own. Fifteen wounded soldiers lie inside: bandage the critically injured first, then the badly injured, then the injured, before any die (show the health bars with Ctrl+V). Turn the quest in the moment fifteen are saved: the others keep dying, and too many deaths fail it even after it reads complete. If it fails, abandon it and take it again.

Steel Bars are smelted from an Iron Bar and a Coal (Mining 165; Coal from trade and blacksmithing suppliers), so each bracer is five of each. Each bracer takes two Heavy Grinding Stones: make them first. Specialisation (optional): at 200 and character level 40, Grumnus Steelshaper (Ironforge) or Okothos Ironrager (Orgrimmar) starts The Art of the Armorsmith: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots and an Ornate Mithril Breastplate, whose plans come from a Mithril Order quest chain. Ironus Coldsteel (Ironforge) or Borgosh Corebender (Orgrimmar) starts The Way of the Weaponsmith: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes and 2 Big Black Maces; on Forever the Moonsteel Broadsword plans (Zarena Cromwind, Booty Bay) and Massive Iron Axe plans bind when picked up, so buy and use them yourself. You can take only one; neither is needed for 300, and the beta never tested them (it stopped at level 30). Needs an anvil nearby.

If you sat at your starting area's campfire for The Great Outdoors, the camping guide there also offers Camping 101: Herbalism: hand it in to the herbalism trainer it names once you reach skill 20, for the Incense Candle recipe.

Pools (floating wreckage, schools of fish) also give extra loot. Nightcrawlers (+50 from skill 50, 1s each) are twice as strong as a Shiny Bauble. The Strong Fishing Pole (+5 from skill 10, 9s 1c) is in limited stock at fishing vendors: buy it when you see it. Fish get away here below skill 75; a lure on the pole adds to your skill for ten minutes and closes the gap. To cook what you catch: Recipe: Longjaw Mud Snapper for the Raw Longjaw Mud Snapper of lakes and rivers (Cooking 50, 4s: Harn Longcast (Mulgore) or Naal Mistrunner (Thunder Bluff)); Recipe: Rainbow Fin Albacore for the Raw Rainbow Fin Albacore of the coast (Cooking 50, 4s: Zansoa (Durotar) or Shankys (Orgrimmar)). Oily Blackmouth from the schools here is no food: alchemists make Blackmouth Oil from it (Alchemy 80); keep it to sell or trade.

steps.title: Learn Skinning
steps.note: Any Skinning trainer of your faction teaches Apprentice Skinning at any level (10c), and so does the Junior Skinning Trainer in each starting area; the arrow picks the nearest. Buy a Skinning Knife from a trade goods or general vendor: keep it in your bags, you cannot skin without it. The first-hour quest of each starting area (Rascally Rodents, Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery, The Woodland Protector, Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise, A Humble Task, Marla's Last Wish) offers Pelt Collecting for Beginners as a reward: reading it gives 2 skill, up to 15. Trade goods vendors and the junior trainers sell the Apprentice's Skinning Satchel, a four-slot bag for leather and hides (25c). If you sat at your starting area's campfire for The Great Outdoors, the camping guide there also offers Camping 101: Skinning: hand it in to the skinning trainer it names once you reach skill 20, for the Camp Chair recipe.
